metadata.description: Agent plugins for Open Memory Lab: memory where every write is held, reviewed by another identity, and only then shared.

plugins.name: oml
plugins.description: Remember and recall through an Open Memory Lab server over MCP. Writes are held until a different identity ratifies them.

plugins.name: oml-admin
plugins.description: Issue an Open Memory Lab agent key from Claude Code. The key value goes to an owner-only file and never into the conversation.
